ticket-priorities.empty_body: Add a ticket priority so support tickets can be ranked by urgency.
ticket-priorities.no_match_body: Check the spelling or clear the search to see every ticket priority.
ticket-priorities.name_too_long: Keep the priority name to {max} characters or fewer.

errors.ERP-CORE-0004: This ticket priority no longer exists. It may have been removed.
errors.ERP-TICKETPRIORITIES-0001: A ticket still uses this priority, so it can't be deleted. Change the priority of those tickets first, then delete it.
errors.ERP-TICKETPRIORITIES-0002: This priority is the default for tickets opened by email piping, so it can't be deleted. Choose another default priority first, then delete it.
